STEPS MODE: navigate to gameplay step-by-step.
These steps are worded to help StepIntentParser, Element Registry, and Set-of-Mark grounding resolve the correct visual target.
goal: Bloons TD6 full gameplay test — launch, place a tower, and survive Round 1
steps: Wait for 20 seconds for the welcome screen to appear
Tap the "START" text button on the welcome menu to reach the main menu screen
Tap the "PLAY" text button on the main menu to reach the map selection screen
Select the first available map thumbnail card on the map selection screen, for example "Monkey Meadow"
Dismiss any tutorial overlay, tip dialog, or close icon that appears
Tap the green square start icon with a white triangle in the bottom-right corner
Verify the gameplay is active by checking that Round, Lives, or Cash are visible
